description.value: St. Augustine's is a neighbourhood institution on Vancouver's Commercial Drive, named after the patron saint of brewers and pouring craft beer continuously since 2008. With 60 rotating taps drawing heavily from BC microbreweries, a full gastropub kitchen, and a sun-drenched patio, it anchors East Van's craft beer culture. A pop-up New Haven-style pizzeria (Industry Apizza) operates inside, and 13+ screens make it a go-to for sports alongside a pint.
